Diamond & Pearl series · SW

Secret Wonders

Released November 1, 2007 · 132 cards

Secret Wonders is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Diamond & Pearl series, released in English on November 1, 2007. It has 132 cards. It includes 120 Pokémon, 10 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

25 illustrators worked on Secret Wonders. Most cards: Ken Sugimori (26), Kouki Saitou (15), Kagemaru Himeno (12), Kazuyuki Kano (12), Masakazu Fukuda (10), Daisuke Ito (8), Mitsuhiro Arita (8), Ryo Ueda (8).
